evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./scope/discovery_complete: Checks that getEndpointsList and the getNetworkInventoryItems lists of the Active Directory folder were each read to their last page. A list longer than the collector reads gives false, and a failed call gives null.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./scope/observed_device_count: Counts the distinct endpoint IDs that getEndpointsList and the Active Directory folder list, of every machine type.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./scope/max_observation_age_seconds: Writes ten years in seconds, since every computer counts however long ago it last synced with Control Center.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./fleet/devices_present: Checks whether getEndpointsList or the Active Directory folder lists any endpoint with machineType 1.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./fleet/device_count: Counts the distinct endpoints with machineType 1 that getEndpointsList and the Active Directory folder list.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./fleet/managed_device_count: Counts the computers whose endpoint list row has isManaged true.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./fleet/devices_by_os/*: Counts the computers in each OS family, read from the operatingSystemVersion name such as Windows 11 Pro or Ubuntu 24.04.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./protection/antimalware_installed_pct: Divides the computers with the antimalware module on in getManagedEndpointDetails by the computers with a reading, rounded down, and counts a computer without the agent as off.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./protection/antimalware_healthy_pct: Divides the computers with the antimalware module on, agent.licensed 1, and agent.signatureOutdated false in getManagedEndpointDetails by the computers with a reading, rounded down.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./protection/edr_installed_pct: Divides the computers with the edrSensor module on in getManagedEndpointDetails by the computers with a reading, rounded down, and counts a computer without the agent as off.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./metric_coverage/*/passing_device_count: Counts the computers whose reading passed for this percentage.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./metric_coverage/*/failing_device_count: Counts the computers whose reading failed for this percentage, including each computer without the agent.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./metric_coverage/*/unknown_device_count: Counts the computers whose getManagedEndpointDetails answer left out a value this percentage needs.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./metric_coverage/*/not_applicable_device: Writes 0, since each percentage applies to every computer.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./devices/*/in_scope: Writes true for every row, since each row is an endpoint with machineType 1.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./devices/*/protection_modules/*/enabled: Reads the module's antimalware, edrSensor, firewall, or deviceControl flag in getManagedEndpointDetails.
evidencepack/endpoint-posture@v1./devices/*/protection_modules/*/healthy: Is true for the antimalware module when it is on with agent.licensed 1 and agent.signatureOutdated false, and is left out for the other modules.
